description: Use when the user asks about a specific Dutch home or address before renting, buying or moving: full English report with year built, floor area, energy label, crime vs national rate, noise, air quality (NO2, PM2.5), ground height, monuments, permits, schools, 18 amenity distances, neighbourhood income and home values. Input: postcode + house number. Sources: Kadaster, CBS, Politie, RIVM, RVO. Costs 0.04 USDC via x402, or 20 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

q.description: Alternative to postcode: free-text address, e.g. 'Visschersplein 1 Utrecht'

name: nl_home_report
title: Dutch address report (paid)
